title: Software Engineers Who Only Code Are Running Out of Time
description: Google says 75% of its new code is generated by AI and Anthropic says over 90% of its codebase contributions are written by Claude, so there is one thing left that a software engineer actually gets paid for.

I walk through the four versions of the engineer on the AAARRR pirate funnel, then the hiring numbers, with 71% of the increase going to senior roles and entry level jobs only 4.5% of software postings, to show who falls behind.

chapters.CH4: The Four Versions of the Engineer

keywords: how to stay relevant as a software engineer
